svg.aria-label: The front end: samples, one pressure reading every 62.5 microseconds, are cut into overlapping 25 ms frames, a new one every 10 ms; each frame becomes 257 evenly spaced frequency bins, merged into 128 mel bands, narrow at low pitch and wide at high pitch; the frames side by side form the log-mel spectrogram, one column per frame and one row per band
svg.text: 25 ms each, a new one every 10 ms
ONE FRAME: BINS TO MEL BANDS
LOG-MEL SPECTROGRAM: ONE COLUMN PER FRAME
